item.title: Homes And Businesses In Ennis Without Water Due To Burst Main
item.description: Homes and businesses in Ennis are without water today due to a burst water main. Uisce Éireann has confirmed that the burst, which took place this morning, is impacting customers on the Mill Road and surrounding areas of the county town.
